description:
Place an immediate test call for a reminder so the user can hear it right now.

    The phone will ring within seconds — only do this when the user has asked to test,
    and never repeatedly. It consumes one call from their quota and does not change
    the schedule.

    Args:
        reminder_id: Reminder to test (from list_reminders).
name: test_call
title: Place a test call now
